_about: Inorganic graph edges never used to build a question (inorg_qfirst._graph). From the blind graph audit of 2026-11-24 (tools/audit_inorg_graph.py, outputs/inorg_graph_audit.json), checked by hand; the author asked for them to be removed. Kept here, not deleted from the graph, so a rebuild from the concept book cannot bring them back.

wrong.CuSO4_to_Cu(OH)2_cuso: conditions say excess NH3: the product is [Cu(NH3)4]2+, not Cu(OH)2
wrong.Na_to_Na2O_na: conditions say excess O2 gives the peroxide: Na2O2, not Na2O
wrong.Mg3N2_to_MgO_mgn: Mg3N2 + D2O gives Mg(OD)2 and ND3, not MgO
wrong.HgCl2_to_Hg2Cl2_hgcl: the reducing agent (SnCl2) is missing; conditions belong to another reaction
wrong.K[PtCl3(C2H4)]·H2O_to_C2H4_kptclchho: no reagent: a description of Zeise's salt, not a reaction
wrong.CoCl3_to_[Co(NH3)3Cl3]_cocl: Werner: three edges with the same reaction text and different products
wrong.CoCl3_to_[Co(NH3)4Cl2]Cl_cocl: Werner: same text as the other two
wrong.CoCl3_to_[Co(NH3)5Cl]Cl2_cocl: Werner: same text as the other two
wrong.HCO2-_to_HCO2Ag_agno: conditions mix two outcomes (white precipitate cold, black Ag on boiling)
wrong.AgCl_to_Ag2O_agcl: AgCl does not give Ag2O with aqueous NaOH as a textbook reaction
wrong.B4H10_to_B2H6_bh: heating B4H10 gives higher boranes (B5H9, B5H11), not B2H6
wrong.SOCl2_to_H2SO3_socl: SOCl2 + H2O gives SO2 + 2HCl, not H2SO3 (graph audit 2026-11-26, approved by the reviewer); the right reaction is the variant cv_socl2_h2o

depends_on_conditions.KOH_to_KHCO3_koh: K2CO3 or KHCO3 by the CO2 ratio
depends_on_conditions.NaOH_to_NaSH_naoh: NaSH or Na2S by the ratio
depends_on_conditions.CuSO4_to_[Cu(NH3)4]SO4·H2O_cuso: Cu(OH)2 first; the complex only with excess NH3 (not stated)
depends_on_conditions.Fe2O3_to_Fe_feo: 600-900 °C spans the stages: Fe3O4, FeO or Fe
depends_on_conditions.SiO2_to_H2[SiF6]_sio: SiF4 or H2SiF6 by the HF amount
depends_on_conditions.Fe3+_to_Fe(SCN)3_kscn: written as Fe(SCN)3 or [Fe(SCN)]2+ (blood red): dropped by the live check in runs 5 and 6
